NO_DYNAMIC_OPPORTUNITY: No supported opportunity and no justified bounded measurement
DYNAMIC_NO_UTILITY_GAIN: Legal stable dynamic comparisons executed, no qualifying utility gain
DYNAMIC_EXPLORATORY_POSITIVE_ONLY: Positive development candidate, independent gate unpassed or not run
DYNAMIC_NOT_REPRODUCED: Positive development candidate fails independent reproduction
DYNAMIC_EVIDENCE_GAP: Missing or illegal comparisons; effect cannot be determined
